metadata.physical_model: Regular deep-water component plus damped pitch/roll/heave and prescribed orbital surge; single effective knife-edge wave obstruction; deterministic threshold; known target elevation; ideal zero-latency per-spoke pose; level stabilized pointing.

assumptions.phase_cycle: independent seeded uniform random wave phases
assumptions.irregular: seven independent random phases, prescribed spectrum with equal wave-elevation RMS to regular case
assumptions.measurement_noise: Sensitivity only: independent zero-mean Gaussian bearing and slant-range error with prescribed standard deviations 0.25 deg and 0.25 m; common draws pair processing cases. These illustrative error distributions are not derived from manufacturer specifications.
assumptions.caveat: Target visit times are prescribed on a uniform schedule at a quarter scan from the pose timestamp; platform motion does not shift spoke acquisition time. Known instantaneous target height is supplied to inverse geometry. Detection is deterministic, with no clutter or receiver noise.

metadata.confidence: 95% normal interval of the mean across independently sampled phase realizations; gains paired per realization
